name: courtship_song_roi_mapping_v3

experiments.readout: vPN1 cell-body GCaMP6m and vPN1 perturbation

experiments.mapping_rule: no per-neuron R71G01 expression field in local MaleCNS annotation table

experiments.readout: peak GCaMP6m ΔF/F in dsxGAL4 pC1 neurites in LPC
experiments.driver: dsxGAL4; selected pC1 neurites in the lateral protocerebral complex
experiments.mapping_rule: requires driver-expression and neurite/ROI overlap, neither is a field in the local IR

annotation_candidates.rule: type starts with pC1 and fruDsx is nonempty
type starts with pC1 and fruDsx starts with coexpress
type starts with pC1 and synonym has pMP-e or pMP4

external_evidence_requirements: A versioned, sex- and age-matched R71G01∩dsx expression-to-bodyId table, or an explicit morphology registration protocol with one-to-one bodyId assignments.
For calcium comparison, an ROI/neurite mask or an explicit bodyId-to-ROI membership rule in the same template space.
For quantitative calibration, raw or digitized experimental traces plus acquisition/normalization metadata; no values may be silently inferred from a plot.
scope: Mapping provenance audit only. It changes neither the Step-2 IR nor any Step-3/4 simulation parameter or verdict.
